definitions.explanation: A conception of something in its most perfect form; a standard of excellence to aspire to.

notes:
{理想|りそう} refers to a vision of perfection — what something should ideally be. Often contrasted with ⟦{現実|げんじつ}→現実：02720_genjitsu⟧ (reality).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {理想|りそう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧〜: ideal ~ (e.g., {理想|りそう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧ = ideal partner)
- {理想|りそう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{現実|げんじつ}→現実：02720_genjitsu⟧: ideals and reality
- {理想|りそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{追|お}う→追う：02016_ou⟧: to pursue ideals
- {理想|りそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掲|かか}げる→掲げる：12791_kakageru⟧: to uphold ideals
- ⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧{理想|りそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to have high ideals

- {理想|りそう}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧: ideal (na-adjective) — e.g., {理想|りそう}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧な⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧ (ideal environment)
